_meta.notes: TWO Type-of-Report boxes are checked - both the Year-End (January 31) box AND the Final / Dissolution box - and both are recorded. Every Summary Page figure writes the cents as a RAISED SUPERSCRIPT over a short rule (958 with a superscript 25, 4,251 with a superscript 51, 3,293 with a superscript 26, 39,444 with a superscript 21); re-rendered at 500 dpi and transcribed with a decimal point. All carry a written '$', kept verbatim. Line 7 is a slashed zero, consistent with a dissolved account. Signed 11-18-10 but not clerk-stamped until JAN 03 2011. Form arithmetic checks out (3,293.26 + 958.25 = 4,251.51).

Both gates also settle the raised-superscript cents on every row (e.g. p4 row 5 '76 68' = 76.68).
itemized.escalation_note: p3 DATE column at 900 dpi (whole column in one tight crop) because this hand's 8 and 9 are close; it resolved rows 1 and 3 to 29 and row 2 to 28, leaving the rows slightly out of chronological order as printed.
itemized.notes: 4-page filing, standard order: p1 cover, p2 Summary Page (totals tranche, not redone), p3 Schedule A (4 rows), p4 Schedule B (6 rows). Both schedule pages are headed 'Votaw' and hand-numbered 'Page 3 of 4' / 'Page 4 of 4'; the Date of Report box is left blank on both. The form checks BOTH the Year-End (January 31) box and the Final / Dissolution box. Cents are written throughout as raised superscripts over a short rule and are transcribed with a decimal point; both page gates confirm them. PRIVACY: the Complete Mailing Address column is blank on the scan for all four contributors (a faint ink fragment survives at the column head of row 1), so no city or state could be recorded. The fourth contribution is from the candidate himself. The last expenditure (11/15/10, $2,750.00 consulting fee to Randy O'Hara) post-dates the general election and is the largest line in the filing.
